## Checklist / 清单

- [ ] I have the rights to submit the chart and grant its data under CC BY-SA 4.0 per CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Chart author, music/cover authors, licence text URLs and asset-specific evidence URLs are in info.json and CREDITS.md.
- [ ] Every conversion has the original mapper's permission_url; I disclosed its origin.
- [ ] No commercial song is included without permission that allows redistribution in this free game.
- [ ] `python tools/validate_fan_chart.py <slug>` passed locally; summary included below.
- [ ] I played the chart myself.
- [ ] Script plugins are disclosed for maintainer review; automated script-disabled results are not a claim about enabled script behavior.
- [ ] Only my submission folder changed; no songs/index.json edits or editor state.
